title: kv-cache-adaptive-eviction-spillover-defrag-heuristics-v15
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Improved KV cache adaptive eviction and defragmentation heuristics: reduces spillover, lowers memory fragmentation, improves P99 latency and cost under mixed-length workloads. No API changes; configuration knobs available.
description: Context: customers and internal canaries observed increased KV cache fragmentation under mixed short/long sequence workloads leading to paging/spillover to host memory and occasional high tail latency / OOMs in densely-packed GPU pools. Motivation: existing LRU-based eviction and opportunistic compaction were not robust against high-fragmentation workloads and could exacerbate spillover during transient load spikes. Summary: Implement an adaptive eviction/defragmentation subsystem that combines size-aware eviction scoring with background compaction and a paging-aware spillover policy. Key points: 1) New size-aware eviction score: incorporates last-access time, token-count footprint, and fragmentation penalty to prefer evicting many small stale entries over a few large hot entries. 2) Per-shard defragmenter: background compaction tasks run at low priority to coalesce free blocks and reduce fragmentation; compaction is gated by a fragmentation metric and GPU load. 3) Spillover paging policy: when available GPU cache drops below threshold, spill to host in page-aligned chunks and schedule async prefetch when predicted hotness is high. 4) Scheduler integration: the inference scheduler now exposes low-util windows so defrag compaction tasks run without impacting latency SLOs; compaction is paused under high tail-latency signals. 5) Safety & fallbacks: if compaction or paging fails, system falls back to conservative eviction-only mode and emits detailed metrics/alerts. Implementation details: - runtimes/kv_cache/allocator.rs: introduced SegmentedAllocator with free-list coalescing and fragmentation accounting. - runtimes/kv_cache/eviction.rs: new adaptive scoring function, eviction workers, and size-bucket policies. - runtimes/kv_cache/defrag.rs: background compaction pipeline with low-priority GPU streams and preemption hooks. - runtimes/kv_cache/paging.rs: host spillover code, page alignment, async prefetch heuristics and rate limiting. - metrics/kv_cache: fragmentation_ratio, compaction_cycles, spill_bytes, prefetch_hits. - config knobs: KVCACHE_ADAPTIVE_EVICTION (bool), KVCACHE_FRAG_THRESHOLD (float), KVCACHE_COMPACT_WINDOW_MS, KVCACHE_SPILL_PAGE_SIZE. Backwards compatibility: feature is off by default for older clusters; enabled by default on new clusters after canary. Migration: safe to enable; no model or API changes. Testing & benchmarks: - Unit tests added for allocator coalescing, scoring, and paging fallback. - Integration tests simulating mixed short/long sequence loads and forced high fragmentation. - Benchmarks: ran bench/fragmentation_bench.py against r5-gpu fleet: observed ~18% reduction in P99 latency under mixed workloads and ~12% lower spill volume, ~7% lower token cost in sustained scenarios. CI: initial CI run found a flaky compaction race; fixed by adding an atomic compaction state machine. Final CI status: pass. Review notes: see review conversation below. Rollout plan: canary on dedicated clusters (10% of capacity) for 48 hours, monitor fragmentation_ratio and P99; if stable, ramp to 100% over 7 days. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Benchmarks - [x] Metrics/dashboards added - [x] Rollout plan included - [x] Documentation updated (docs/perf/kv-cache-eviction.md) Related Linear: ENG-5124 (eviction improvements), ENG-4890 (kv cache paging).

review_comments: Diego Morales: Left a few nits on allocator naming and suggested making compaction window configurable per-shard. Asked for a benchmark against 1:10 short:long ratio.
Asha Patel (author): Responded that naming nits addressed, compaction window is now per-shard and exposed via KVCACHE_COMPACT_WINDOW_MS. Added 1:10 bench results to description.
Evelyn Chen: Requested extra telemetry for prefetch hit-rate and a guard to prevent prefetch storms; suggested rate-limiting implementation which was added.
Ravi Singh: Approve after CI fixes; asked to ensure rollout plan includes a safety cutoff (fragmentation_ratio > 0.6 triggers auto-disable).
notes: Config to enable: KVCACHE_ADAPTIVE_EVICTION=true (disabled by default on existing clusters)
If customers see regression, set KVCACHE_ADAPTIVE_EVICTION=false to revert quickly
